prompt: Some people believe that university education should be free for everyone. Others believe that students should pay for their university education. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
essay:
While many individuals believe that university education should be free for all students, others think that students should pay for their own education. From my perspective, universities should provide free education because this can give more people the opportunity to study and build a successful career.

One reason why some people think that university education should be free is that it can help students from different financial backgrounds to achieve their educational goals. This is mainly because if students do not need to pay high amounts of money for their education, they can focus more on their studies and achieve higher grades. As a result, they will have more chances to enter good universities and find better job opportunities in the future. For instance, if a student comes from a family with limited financial resources, free university education can help him complete his studies without having to worry about paying expensive tuition fees.

On the other hand, others believe that students should pay for their university education because this can reduce the financial pressure on governments. This is mainly because universities require a lot of money to provide high quality education and maintain their facilities. As a result, if students pay some of the costs, governments can spend their financial resources on other important services such as healthcare and public transport. For example, when students pay tuition fees, the government can use the money that it saves to improve other public services and provide better facilities for citizens.

In conclusion, although making students pay for their university education can reduce the financial pressure on governments, I believe that university education should be free because it can give students from different backgrounds equal opportunities to achieve their educational and career goals.
